Tuesday

The cultural context of the Scottish Highlands significantly shapes the expression of themes in the text. The rugged, isolated landscape of the highlands historically necessitates a strong reliance on community for survival, thereby elevating the theme of communal value. Furthermore, the specific mention of "modernization" against this backdrop highlights a tension between traditional pastoral lifestyles and contemporary changes, which intensifies the theme of preserving cultural identity. The shepherd, Ewan, serves as a cultural symbol rooted in this specific geography, making the struggle for survival not just a personal challenge but a reflection of the broader societal shift affecting Highland communities.
